restoration_note: This teaching maps Eudaimonia, Sophia, and Power across three registers: the natural world (where they pass), the cosmic order (recognized as gift), and the Lord himself (Father, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador / Mind, Virgin of Light, Pillar of Glory, Five Sons). Editor restorations carried the bulk of the work; lexical anchors (Pillar of Glory, Virgin of Light, Light Mind, Five Sons of First Man, Land of Light, aeons of greatness) constrained the larger gaps. Sections 107-108 are whole-line lacunae with no formula to anchor and are honestly marked unrestorable. Several smaller bridging gaps in §90-92, §95-96, §113, §117 admit only low-confidence proposals because the grammar permits multiple cohesive fillers.
